expectation: Membrane ring on most epithelial cells (basolateral in polarized epithelium); common; should outline the epithelium and glands in a honeycomb or palisade pattern, with stroma and lumen dimmer.
observed: A: bright honeycomb on the epithelial and glandular folds, stroma and background dark. B: crisp polygonal membrane network and columnar epithelium. C: a gland lined by columnar cells with lateral membranes stained and a dark lumen. D: lateral membranes outlined around the nuclei.
why: Crisp membrane rings outline the epithelial and glandular cells, while the lumen and stroma stay dark, as expected for Na/K-ATPase.
notes: Strong, specific membrane staining of the epithelium across the whole tissue: honeycomb outlines and columnar gland linings with sharp lateral membranes. The stroma and background are dark.
